title: Resting bids: the engine DOES have them
body: The engine had ~490-600 bids resting ($120-166) and was posting/filling normally, so your fill notifications are real. The Engine tab showed 0 because desk.json had grown to 12.5 MB (about 11,900 cancelled/expired bids kept for 3 h) and the phone could not load it. Fixed: ended unfilled bids are now kept 15 min. I restarted the engine on the new code; the tab should show the bids again once the new file is published (a minute or two, pull down to refresh). v0.117.1 (SX live feed, address gate) is building now.
